body:
Dear Daniel Woods,

We received a request to change the remittance (payment) details on the account for Little, Edwards and Johnson. We have not made any changes yet.

Before we update anything, we need to verify the request. Please confirm whether you or someone at Little, Edwards and Johnson asked for a change to your payment details.

- If you did not make this request, please let us know right away by replying to this email, and do not send payments using any new bank or remittance instructions.
- If you did make the request, please confirm it through a phone number or contact on your existing invoices or our website, not through contact details included in the request.

We will not apply any change until it has been verified.

Thank you for your help.

Billing Team
